name: Page size 10 shows that many rows and the right number of pages
description:

Preconditions: Open User Management with the configured test data.

2. Page size 10 shows that many rows and the right number of pages.

statusMessage:
AssertionError: assert 50 == 10
 +  where 50 = len(['QA Cleanup Paige Collins', 'Chetana M', 'Lee Law', 'Underwriter Two', 'Underwriter One', 'Arjun key', ...])
 +    where ['QA Cleanup Paige Collins', 'Chetana M', 'Lee Law', 'Underwriter Two', 'Underwriter One', 'Arjun key', ...] = visible_row_names()
 +      where visible_row_names = <pages.user_management_page.UserManagementPage object at 0x130e084b0>.visible_row_names
 +  and   10 = min(10, 106)
statusTrace:
tests/e2e/admin/test_user_management.py:492: in test_user_management_rows_per_page_options_are_available
    assert len(users.visible_row_names()) == min(page_size, total)
